meta.name: optimize
meta.description: Improve interface performance across loading speed, rendering, animations, images, and bundle size. Makes experiences faster and smoother.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提升网页加载速度与渲染流畅度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为网页加载慢或动画卡顿而烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Boost web page loading speed and rendering smoothness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are struggling with slow page loads or choppy animations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析网页或应用的加载速度、渲染、动画、图片和代码体积，找出性能瓶颈并给出优化建议，比如压缩图片、拆分代码、减少重排等。
howto.when: 当你描述一个界面或功能存在卡顿、加载慢、动画不流畅等问题，或直接要求优化性能时触发。

say.text: 我的网站首页加载很慢，怎么优化？
say.note: Claude 会分析可能原因并给出具体优化步骤。

say.text: 这个 React 列表滚动时卡顿，怎么改善？
say.note: Claude 会建议虚拟滚动、减少重渲染等方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes loading speed, rendering, animations, images, and bundle size of a web page or app, identifies performance bottlenecks, and provides optimization suggestions such as compressing images, code splitting, and reducing layout thrashing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a UI or feature that is slow, laggy, or not smooth, or when you directly ask for performance optimization.

say_en.text: My website homepage loads very slowly, how can I optimize it?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze possible causes and give specific optimization steps.

say_en.text: This React list is laggy when scrolling, how to improve?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest virtual scrolling, reducing re-renders, etc.
